study_boundary.purpose: measure the incremental effect of structured role separation, task contracting, and independent verification after tool access has already been introduced in B1

research_questions: Does a fixed-role multi-agent pipeline improve final-answer and execution accuracy over the B1 tool-augmented single agent under the same six-model-call ceiling?
How much of any B2 change is associated with the task-contract role and the independent verifier role?
What quality-cost and coverage-human-review trade-offs arise from the multi-agent pipeline?

development_hypotheses.statement: Full B2 will have higher descriptive final-answer and execution accuracy than frozen B1-v1.2 on the same registered30 development set.
development_hypotheses.reason: The 30-item set has already been used for development and interface diagnosis.

development_hypotheses.statement: Removing the task-contract agent will reduce contract compliance or downstream answer quality relative to full B2.
Removing the verifier agent will increase answer coverage but may reduce reliability relative to full B2.

architecture.role_isolation: Each role starts a fresh model conversation and receives only controller-approved structured artifacts from prior roles; reasoning text is neither shared nor retained.

roles.name: evidence_agent
roles.output: evidence packet containing only exact returned labels and text

roles.name: solver_agent
roles.output: candidate prediction whose program must equal the executed canonical program

roles.name: verifier_agent
roles.output: accept or human_review verdict with four Boolean checks and reason codes

conflict_resolution.accepted_output: The solver candidate is returned only when all deterministic checks pass and, when present, the verifier accepts with all checks true.
conflict_resolution.rejected_output: Any verifier rejection or deterministic check failure changes status to human_review and clears the answer; there is no model repair or retry.
conflict_resolution.rationale: Prevent the verifier from introducing an unsearched claim or an unexecuted replacement program.

frozen_common_configuration.reasoning_configuration: provider default; no reasoning field is sent
frozen_common_configuration.temperature_configuration: provider default; no temperature field is sent
frozen_common_configuration.calculator: unchanged B1-v1.2 deterministic structured FinQA calculator
frozen_common_configuration.budget_comparability: Full B2 and frozen B1-v1.2 have the same maximum six model calls and cumulative 32768 output-token budget per sample. Actual calls, tokens, and latency are reported.

outcomes.interpretation: Development differences are descriptive only. No p-value, confidence interval, causal claim, or final-performance claim will be made from these 30 items.
